data.display_address: Naya at District One, District One, Mohammed Bin Rashid City, Dubai
data.long_description:
Naya is a resort project by Nakheel consisting of 3 towers - 13, 17 and 20 storeys, located on the shores of the man-made Crystal Lagoon in District One.

The project offers a variety of stylish 1-3 bedroom apartments and 6 luxurious 4-bedroom penthouses. There are also spacious 3 bedroom ground floor villas. All residences are presented with a balcony. The two and more bedroom options have fitted wardrobes in the bedrooms and laundry facilities. All kitchens have the necessary appliances from well-known brands. The panoramic windows offer stunning views.

The residents of the complex have access to a variety of exclusive amenities: landscaped swimming pools, several gyms, including outdoor, children's playground and children's pool, a green garden with walking and jogging paths and places to relax, sports field, basketball court, beach by the lagoon.

The complex is located in the centre of the rapidly developing area MBR City. The infrastructure of the area is actively developed, within a few minutes drive there are many supermarkets, hospitals, entertainment and educational institutions. The famous Ras Al Khor Nature Reserve is just 10 minutes away, Business Bay, Downtown Dubai and Dubai Mall are just 15 minutes away, and Dubai International Airport is 25 minutes away.

Finance is available on this property through Premier Property Finance. Call us on +97143233609 for a free consultation.
